title: AI-Infused Development: Lessons Learned and Patterns from Esri Engineers
summary: An Esri developer-outreach talk surveying AI coding use cases (tools, translation, tests, docs, debugging via MCP), workflows like spec-driven development, and risks and mitigations.

assertions.quote: there are a lot of organizations that are using as I was saying multiple models depending on the task
how useful it became to translate an application built from one language to another

verdicts.note: Migration case studies (Airbnb, Google) show large time savings on translation and migration, but output still needs review and deterministic tooling helps.

One participant reported that Copilot sped up their work by translating constructs from familiar languages into Java/Spring idioms. This is a single anecdote about snippet-level translation, not whole applications.
Google authors' related-work aside: prior LLM approaches to language translation 'do not reach high enough quality to become useful yet' (an opinion on the literature, not a measurement).
